manipulators.description: Center window (force float + center via grid)

to.shell_command: /usr/bin/open -a "Brave Browser"; ATTEMPT=0; TARGET=""; while [ "$ATTEMPT" -lt 20 ] && [ -z "$TARGET" ]; do TARGET=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/yabai -m query --windows | /opt/homebrew/bin/jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.app == "Brave Browser")) | select(. != null) | "\(.space) \(.id)"'); [ -n "$TARGET" ] || { ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT + 1)); /bin/sleep 0.05; }; done; [ -n "$TARGET" ] || exit 0; SPACE_ID=${TARGET%% *}; WINDOW_ID=${TARGET##* }; /opt/homebrew/bin/yabai -m space --focus "$SPACE_ID" && /opt/homebrew/bin/yabai -m window --focus "$WINDOW_ID"
